footnotes: The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 40-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 80.2% to $2.3B in 2025. Gross margin was 85.4%, versus 81.7% a year earlier, and operating income rose 2.5× to $1.6B, a 68.3% margin.
Net income rose 2.8× to $1.5B, or $3.24 per share. Operating cash flow was $1.9B and free cash flow $1.9B, versus $1.0B; Wheaton Precious Metals returned $296M through dividends.
